note: Station levels are taken from the accepted skeleton (-LEAN, rest pose) by skeletal_stations.levels; protected relations are read on the unorganized route (composition-infimum) at those levels and are fixed by the skeleton: the sculpt cannot and must not change them. Organized-surface readings are diagnostics only (05E author ruling 2).

canon_relations.GO-P2b: bitrochanteric / iliac-crest breadth ~ MF (no lateral outrigging) - on the skeleton
canon_relations.GO-P4: pelvic AP depth / iliac-crest breadth > MF and > SK - on the skeleton
canon_relations.GO-P6: thorax -> lower trunk -> pelvis with no abrupt step in breadth or depth; waist definition allowed
canon_relations.GO-G1: shoulder-joint breadth / thoracic breadth not greater than MF (no girdle overhang)
